description: DROPPED (freesoexperiment-3df): no wire path. The `!`-prefixed commands (`!del`, `!roomat`, `!objat`, `!debugroutes`, `!vc`, etc.) are dispatched entirely client-side by the stock client's UICheatHandler — the server's VMNetChatCmd.Execute has no `!` branch. The only cheat command that produces a wire PDU is `!del`, which emits VMNetDeleteObjectCmd — that's covered by the build-buy-catalog family's delete-object op (d87-d-buy/build). A headless bot has no UICheatHandler, so a literal `!foo` string over VMNetChatCmd would just appear as chat. Declaration is retained as a catalog marker (status=dropped) so a future sweep finds the trail; NO HANDLER is registered by AdminHandlers / admin_handlers.go.
common_mistakes: Requires your VM permissions == Admin (moderation_level>=1 server-side). Non-admins fail deterministically with 'caller is not an admin (current_permissions=...)'.
ModerationRequest EntityId is an avatar_id; ArchiveModerationRequest EntityId is a user_id (NOT an avatar_id) — archive-approve-user/archive-reject-user target users, not Sims.
Self-targeting is refused by the handler.
perception_hints: Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (for physically-present targets); other avatars need find-avatar or direct knowledge of avatar_id
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-target): perception.avatar.persist_id
Chat activity you may want to moderate: perception.recent_events[] kind=='chat'
refuse_conditions: caller is not admin (VM permissions != Admin) → returns ok:false with 'caller is not an admin (current_permissions=...)'
target_persist_id is 0 or missing → returns ok:false with 'requires target_persist_id (> 0)'
target_persist_id == caller's own avatar_id → returns ok:false with 'refusing to target self'
